summary: Bradford's Instagram record on social services spans homelessness, mental health, addictions, public health, recreation, equity-seeking communities, and support for seniors and newcomers. Bradford supports clearing encampments while pairing removals with shelter offers, outreach workers, supportive housing, and treatment (DTu89cQjtBR, DRDb8H5AUN5, DMK2uOQgteh, DRholf-lx3s). Bradford frames addictions and mental health as provincial health care jurisdiction and calls for a provincial mandatory treatment law, 100 recovery beds, and more residential treatment and supportive housing (DSZ7R5JgJZS, DcJe_umuSko, DcMnGotlW39). Bradford supports refugees and calls for federal funding of asylum-seeker supports (CtW8t0Pp_Ix, DQwumxDjYhU). Bradford champions arts funding, seniors programs, food banks, community centres (Tamil, Black History Society), and pledges to reform the 7am recreation registration system via a lottery model (DCX1fRQNc0a, DJy5tn5tigh, DZIQEviO7nH, DZLdPAgKCiu). Bradford consistently affirms 2SLGBTQ+, Indigenous, Jewish, Muslim, and Tamil communities.
